svg.text: 62 W x 59 D x 110 H mm (lid included); flat foot 44 x 43; shell ~46 cm3, ~153 g with board 30 g + battery 55 g (assumed)
centre of mass 23 behind the foot's front edge, 48 up; tips at ~22° back / 25° forward (worst direction 22°); tilt15: 22 / 29, oval: 18 / 17
The pebble made a real stone: apex 3 left of the tubes, a fuller, lower hip on the right (the board's plug side) that carries the logo, plan skewed to the right at the back.
The front panel (|x| < 19) keeps the oval's symmetric bow, so both slots stay identical; the asymmetry lives outside it.
1 mm = 4 px, grid 10 mm. Blue-grey: stack box s 12..95 (along the face from the rim), t 3..26; dashed in it: real board+glass and battery. Blue: rods 8 x 66.65 at x ±10.23. Red: CoM, flat foot.
